code: Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x 7.5 (conda-forge qe-7.5-hc91ee90_1) through ASE
labelling: computed with DFT-PBE in this project: a model value (PBE), never a measurement

twin.description: (111)[11-2], twinning (easy) sense: upper block displaced along +[11-2]
twin.value_source: maximum of the samples recomputed on the k-refined mesh [12, 12, 12]

k_refined.note: cells (T) and starting ions of the production path; ions re-relaxed on the denser mesh; the lateral stresses were not re-iterated (their change moves sigma_xz by ~0.05 GPa)

twin.max_lateral_residual_note: production-mesh path only (the lateral stresses were iterated there; samples past an instability included)
twin.k_refined_lateral_note: the k-refined samples reuse the production cells and were not re-relaxed laterally; with the stage-1 Cij the linear-elastic coupling of a lateral residual r to sigma_xz is at most 0.26 r, i.e. <= 0.2 GPa here (an estimate: tangent moduli at large strain differ)

literature.source: Y. Umeno, Y. Kinoshita, T. Kitamura, Modelling Simul. Mater. Sci. Eng. 15, 27 (2007), p. 31 text and Fig. 5 (easy sense, normal stresses relaxed)
Z. Wang et al., arXiv:2309.01137 (2023), Sec. 3 and Fig. 6c (preprint; sense not stated)
S. Ogata, private communication quoted in Umeno et al. 2007

records.name: ideal_shear_strength

orientation.description: (111)[11-2], twinning (easy) sense: upper block displaced along +[11-2]

conditions.stress_state: simple shear on (111) with the other five Cauchy stress components relaxed to zero, 0 K

method.name: DFT ideal shear strength: affine simple shear, ions and lateral stresses relaxed
method.description: pw.x, PBE, SSSP_1.3.0_PBE_efficiency, ecutwfc 70 Ry / ecutrho 560 Ry, k-mesh (8, 8, 8) offset (0, 0, 0), gaussian smearing 0.01 Ry, conv_thr 1e-11 Ry/atom; 2-atom primitive cell in the lab frame (x = shear direction, z = [111]); T_xz controlled, the other five T components iterated to |sigma| <= 0.25 GPa; strength = maximum of sigma_xz (parabolic refinement) at engineering strain 0.415
assumptions: 0 K static lattice (no zero-point or thermal effects)
homogeneous deformation of the 2-atom cell: phonon (non-affine) instabilities are not tested, so the value is an upper bound of the ideal strength
lattice parameter and Cij from stage 1 with the same settings

uncertainty.description: k+8 vs k+4 at the refined peak

checks.name: pw_runs_converged
checks.details: 43 pw.x runs: JOB DONE, SCF converged, BFGS converged for relaxations; max SCF iterations 12

checks.name: lateral_stresses_relaxed
checks.details: max |sigma_free| (the five components other than the controlled one) over the path up to the right neighbour of the maximum

checks.name: peak_bracketed
checks.details: stop: stress fell below 0.80 x maximum

checks.name: work_energy_consistency
checks.details: |integral V sigma:dF F^-1 - dE| / dE from 0 to the peak strain

checks.name: small_strain_modulus_vs_Cij
checks.details: stress/strain at strain 0.01 vs the relaxed (111) shear modulus 151.4 GPa from the stage-1 Cij

checks.name: peak_settings_convergence
checks.details: k+8 vs k+4 at the refined peak

checks.name: production_peak_check_superseded
checks.details: production-mesh peak 27.71 GPa; its ecutwfc + 20 Ry / k + 4 check moved the peak sample by -0.57 GPa, so the value is the peak on the k-refined mesh [12, 12, 12]

validation.notes: Comparison, not evidence (different functional or protocol, docs/DFT.md section 2): Y. Umeno, Y. Kinoshita, T. Kitamura, Modelling Simul. Mater. Sci. Eng. 15, 27 (2007), p. 31 text and Fig. 5 (easy sense, normal stresses relaxed), -8.4 %.
